text:
anna: Partner amplification playbook for tomorrow's Optimize post  2 asks: (1) confirm partner tweet copy, (2) ensure shortlinks + UTMs are in partner bundle. Please ack.

kevin: Ack. I'm collating partner copy variants for APAC/EU/US. Will drop into the shared drive by 18:30 PT.

partner-bot: Partner bundle created: gs://redwood-partners/optimize-bundle-v1.zip includes shortlinks.csv, partner-copy.md, logos.zip (created by partner-bot).

leah: Quick note on copy: brands want a plug-and-play 1-line with the canonical stat. Suggested: "We partner with Redwood Inference to deliver up to 3x token throughput on production LLMs." Thoughts?

anna: Good. Trim to: "We partner with Redwood Inference — up to 3x token throughput on production LLMs." Keep the em dash.

kevin: Done. I added a second variant with a localized CTA for EMEA: "Learn how Redwood Optimize reduces inference cost for real workloads."

press-bot: Reminder scheduled: partner bundle email will be sent in 12 hours to partner_contacts@redwood.com.

leah: Also adding a small FAQ for partners about the benchmark phrasing. One Q: "Can we claim cost improvements?" A: "Use the canonical stat only; cost improvements depend on workload. Link to methodology."

anna: Yes please include that FAQ. Partners sometimes overstate numbers in promos.

kevin: Shortlinks + UTMs ready and validated against redirects. Spreadsheet shared in the calendar event.

partner-bot: Partner email queued: subject="Early access: Redwood Optimize launch assets (embargoed)" send_time=1805030600

leah: Last thing: anyone flagged PR contacts that need an embargo waiver? A few partners asked to publish localized blog posts 2 hours after us. We need to confirm allowed timing.

anna: We can allow T+2hr reposts for partners with explicit waiver. kevin, add a column waiver=yes/no in the partner CSV.

kevin: Added waiver column and updated partner bundle.

leah: Thanks. I'll run through the partner list tonight and ping any with missing waivers.

anna: Perfect. If anyone sees partners using non-canonical stat or changing numbers, escalate here and we'll send the correction language. Thanks all :rocket:
